podcast.title: Part of Shoegaze Semi-Revival
podcast.body: A Place to Bury Strangers was identified as part of the "semi-revival" of Shoegaze in the 2010s. This period saw a thriving underground scene for the genre, with new record labels and social media activity supporting its adherents. "The pains of being pure at heart, a place to bury strangers, and school of seven bells were also part of this, let's call it a semi-revival."
